0.26.1: The orchestrator spec is now a spine plus reference files — the always-loaded half shrank 70%.
0.27.0: hooks/estimate.sh is calibrated against measured actuals, and the estimate↔actual token comparison was a unit error.
0.28.0: Run duration was narrated, not measured — it is now stamped by a hook from date -u.
0.29.0: Gate B ran away — 4 to 11 adversarial passes per run, and three of seven runs ended by human fiat rather than by a clean pass.
0.30.0: Bounding Gate B moved the churn one phase upstream — Phase 4 then ran 9 and 5 review rounds against a STANDARD cap of 4.
0.30.1: The mandatory high-risk merge gate is now enforced by the hook itself. Previously it was armed only by a Phase-5 prompt step, so a run that skipped that step could push with no human stop at all.
0.31.0: Verifier and critique agents are now spawned synchronously. The harness began backgrounding them, which returned launch metadata instead of a report and left runs thrashing against the anti-stall hook — eight blocked turn-ends in five minutes on one observed run, with the verifier's work never…
0.32.0: LIGHT-tier runs now get an independent adversarial pass. Previously the model that wrote the diff also self-verified and code-reviewed it, with nothing independent following — on LIGHT the self-review was the only review the code ever got. Also adds an opt-in, off-by-default shadow reviewer…
0.33.0: Phase 4's code review now runs in a fresh-context subagent by default, so the model that wrote the diff is not the model that reviews it. Rounds 2+ read only the delta since the previous round, which is what keeps that independence affordable rather than doubling the review bill.
0.34.0: PR bodies now open with a short plain-prose lede instead of a Summary bullet list, and may carry a "Review this first" section pointing at the few places worth reading before the rest of the diff — a removed guard, a migration, logic that gained no test, or the files the run itself kept…
